readme.text: **A ZCode-style visual skin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web — sidebar, workspace session tree, global search, turn navigation** [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [Apache-2.0](LICENSE) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui) [](https://nodejs.org/)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This is a personal, community-maintained project. It carries no official endorsement.**
> It is **not** a DeepSeek AI product, and it is **not** an official plugin of any kind — it is maintained by one individual (`jungenius-stack`) in their own time.
> It is a fork of the open-source project [MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui) (Apache-2.0), and its design values are taken from [zai-org/ZCode](https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode) (Apache-2.0).
> "DeepSeek", "DeepSeek Harness" and "ZCode" are the property of their respective owners; the names are used here only to describe compatibility and design provenance.

readme.section: Every pixel, measured. Every motion, earned.
readme.text:
**dsh-zcode-ui** is the result of a six-week design-inheritance program in which nothing — not a
single radius, not a single frame of easing — was guessed. We opened ZCode itself with the Chrome
DevTools Protocol and read its computed styles live. We unpacked its startup page and lifted the
keyframes verbatim. We sampled its dialog shadows pixel by pixel. Then we rebuilt that language
inside DeepSeek Harness — 14,480 lines of TypeScript, 85+ modules, one design system.

readme.section: Every pixel, measured. Every motion, earned.
readme.text:
The result doesn't imitate ZCode. It **speaks ZCode, natively, inside another app**.

And it stays fast doing it: sidebar collapse runs a single 300ms glide with **zero long tasks**,
the composer sits flat and still under your cursor, and a cinematic splash — your app icon popping
to life over macOS vibrancy — welcomes you at launch, gone in under a second.

readme.section: Every pixel, measured. Every motion, earned.
readme.text:
**Measured, not estimated. Guarded, not hoped for.** That is the whole philosophy — and it's why
this skin feels less like a theme and more like the interface DeepSeek Harness was meant to have.

---

readme.section: Every pixel, measured. Every motion, earned.
readme.text:
> [!NOTE]
> **Stable since 2.0.0 — currently 2.2.1.** Every visual value in this skin is traceable to a live measurement of ZCode (CDP computed styles or extracted source), guarded by 66 contract assertions, 57 unit/integration test files and 22 real-browser layout checks — `npm run gate` runs them all, and the `pre-push` hook runs the same gate before anything lands on GitHub. Known limitations are still listed openly in [`docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md`](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md).
> Corrections and improvement suggestions are genuinely welcome — please open an [issue](https://github.com/jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui/issues). The most useful report is short: what you expected, what happened, and a screenshot if the problem is visual.

readme.section: Every pixel, measured. Every motion, earned.
readme.text:
DSH ZCode UI repaints the DSH Web interface in ZCode's (Zhipu / Zai) visual language: the sidebar, the workspace session tree, the header search, and the composer all adopt ZCode geometry, palette, and iconography — in both light and dark themes.

**The skin itself changes nothing else.** Everything it draws flows through DSH's own `SlotRegistry` slots and `ctx` public services, and it never writes conversation records.

readme.section: Every pixel, measured. Every motion, earned.
readme.text: One thing worth stating plainly, because the paragraph above used to overstate it: this package is a fork of [`dsh-codex-ui`](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui) and **also carries upstream's non-visual features** — a dependency panel that can run `pnpm` and rewrite `node_modules`, session moves between workspaces, and "open in file manager". They are inherited rather than written here, and they are what the About page exposes. You can simply not use them, but they do ship in this package. See [Scope and permissions](#scope-and-permissions).

Version 2.0.0 is the culmination of a six-week design-inheritance effort. Every visual decision —
784px column width, 32px rows, the two-tier dialog grammar, motion tokens, the startup splash —
is backed by a recorded measurement of ZCode itself, not by eye. The full ledger lives in
[`docs/ZCODE-DESIGN.md`](docs/ZCODE-DESIGN.md); the gaps that were found and closed read like a
changelog of 30+ audit rounds (conversation typography, dialog families, turn-rail motion,
startup splash, title-bar dedup) — each closed with a before/after measurement.

Not a theme file. A full design system, inherited at the token layer — every official surface
recolors as one piece, in both light and dark:

| Area | What the skin does |
| --- | --- |
| **Layout** | ZCode sidebar geometry — 8px radii, 32px rows, `px-2 / py-3 / gap-1` spacing, 150–200ms `ease-out` motion, seven-step type scale |
| **Colour** | Full Zai Light / Zai Dark palettes written into DSH's `--dsw-*` token layer; official regions (title bar, session list, buttons, menus, composer shell) recolour as one piece |
| **Icons** | Lucide (the same icon library ZCode uses) for sidebar navigation and row actions |
| **Theme** | Follows the host's own light/dark preference via `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`; light canvas `#f8f8f8`, dark canvas `#161616` |
| **Sidebar behaviour** | Pin / group / drag-reorder projects and conversations, unread and running indicators, header search over sessions + settings + quick actions, rename / archive / fork / copy / delete, turn navigation in long conversations, Up/Down recall of previous input |
| **Conversation craft** | 784px text column, 20px turn rhythm, 0.35px tracking, right-aligned user bubbles with collapse, ZCode-grade tables and blockquotes, fenced code cards, no horizontal scroll |
| **Motion** | Intent-tiered tokens (enter / feedback / move / press), sidebar collapse in one 300m
The two images at the top of this page are the light and dark sidebar + workspace tree. A few more views.

> Project names, conversation titles and the balance figures in every screenshot are **demo data** — the
> captures are sanitised before committing so no real workspace ever appears in this repository.
>
> **Re-captured for 2.0.0** (2026-10-29) against a live host (`0.2.1-rc.2`): the collapsed rail,
> the pinned titlebar (host's duplicate buttons hidden), the flat composer card and the table/quote
> styling shown here are the shipped 2.0 look.

Settings page — selected states are neutral, matching the sidebar (no blue leftovers from the host defaults):

Collapsed rail — icon-only, expand button on top, footer icons pinned to the bottom (dark):

Header search across conversations and settings:

Collapsed rail — icon-only, with tooltips on hover:

- **The ZCode skin itself** — 178 `--dsw-*` tokens per theme (light and dark) plus 23 structural tokens, 201 unique token names in total. Every token consumed anywhere in `src/` is covered by the maps; the `token-coverage` assertion fails the build if that ever stops being true.
- **Theme single-source-of-truth** — the host attribute is the only signal. No `prefers-color-scheme` fallback, which used to split the sidebar and the content area when the host was light but the OS was dark.
- **Fixes found by looking at the real interface**, not by reading code: session hover card trimmed to the title only, send button rendered in the real primary colour (`--dcu-primary` is now defined at `:root` so the composer — which lives outside `.dcu-root` — can resolve it), a "back to conversation" entry when a global panel is open, self-drawn sidebar separator lines removed, marquee title clipping, footer separation, and shorter empty-state cards.
- **A verification stack that actually runs on this machine** — see [Verification](#verification). Upstream's browser-based layout scripts had never been executed here before (the Chromium binary was missing), which is how five stale assertions stayed h
A skin should not need a permissions conversation. This one does, because it is a fork and inherited more than visuals. Being explicit is cheaper than being trusted by accident.

| Capability | Reachable from | Touches |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Recolour the UI | always, on install | DSH's `--dsw-*` token layer and this plugin's own stylesheets. No data. |
| Sidebar / session tree / search | always, on install | Renders through official slots. Reads session and workspace lists; never writes conversation records. |
| Dependency panel | the About page, on click | Runs `pnpm`, rewrites `node_modules` and `pnpm-workspace.yaml` in the active workspace. |
| Move session to workspace | the session context menu | Rewrites that session's artifact files. |
| Open in file manager | file path menus | Opens the OS file manager. Read-only. |
| Five REST endpoints | the plugin's own UI only | Serves the four features above; authenticated per session. |

Everything in the lower four rows is **inherited from [`dsh-codex-ui`](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui)** and is also exposed on the About page inside DSH. If you only want the skin, nothing here runs unless you click it.

- A working **DeepSeek Harness Web** installation with `dsh` on your `PATH`. Examples below use the `web` profile; substitute your own profile name.
- **Host compatibility.** Peer dependencies declare the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` range `>=0.1.6-alpha.2 <0.3.0-0`; development is pinned to `0.2.0-rc.2`. The heavy gate (`pnpm gate:host`) packs the plugin, installs it into an isolated `DSH_HOME`, and exercises the real `dsh` binary found on the machine — override it with `DCU_DSH_BIN`.
- **Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`** if you build from source.
- ⚠️ On macOS, do **not** put DSH's bundled Node 24 first on `PATH` when building or testing: it cannot load the `rolldown` native binding (`code signature ... different Team IDs`) and `vitest` / `tsdown` will fail. Any other Node 22.22.x works.

The package is **not published to the npm registry**. Install it straight from GitHub instead —
`dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to `pnpm`, which resolves `github:<owner>/<repo>` natively:

```text
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui
```

`lib/` is committed and the package defines no `prepare` script, so nothing is compiled during install.

Paste this into any agent that can run terminal commands on your computer:

```text
Install the DSH plugin dsh-zcode-ui into my local web profile by running:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui
Then run dsh --profile web --dump-config, confirm the configuration includes zcode-ui, and explain how to reload DSH and start using the skin.
```

```powershell
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
$OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui

Restart DSH Web and hard-refresh the browser (usually `Ctrl+Shift+R`). The new sidebar is the sign that the skin is live. Disabling or uninstalling the plugin restores the official interface.

readme.section: Install from a local clone (unreleased changes)
readme.text: `lib/` is committed, so a clone is usable without building — but rebuild after any change to `src/`. **Installing the dependencies must use `pnpm`:** `pnpm-workspace.yaml` uses `packageExtensions` to patch 19 undeclared dependencies of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, and `npm` ignores that mechanism — `npm install` leaves `tsdown` unable to resolve them. Only once dependencies are installed (via pnpm) is running the scripts with `npm run <script>` equivalent.

| Goal | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Start a conversation | **New task**, or the **+** / **New conversation** action on a workspace |
| Find something | Type in the header search field; pick a session, a settings page, or a quick action |
| Collapse the sidebar | The header panel button; the expand control stays on the collapsed rail |
| Return from a global panel | With a panel open, **Back to conversation** appears directly under the panel entry |
| Pin a project | Drag it into **Pinned**, or use **Pin project** in its menu |
| Manage a conversation | Its menu: rename, pin, mark unread, archive, fork, copy, delete |
| Reuse earlier input | Press Up/Down in an empty composer to recall input from this workspace |
| Jump between turns | The turn marks to the left of the current conversation |

**Nothing changed after installing.**
Check that the profile you installed into is the one actually running DSH Web, then restart DSH Web and hard-refresh the browser (`Ctrl+Shift+R`). `dsh --profile web --dump-config` should list `zcode-ui`. If that profile's `cordis.patch.yml` still carries `disabled: true` for `ui-sidebar` or `ui-settings-general`, delete those rows and reload.

**Does it touch my conversations, workspaces, or files?**
Not by itself. The skin only recolours the interface through DSH's `--dsw-*` token layer and renders the sidebar through official slots and public services. It never writes conversation records, and removing a project from the sidebar does not delete its folder.

Two inherited features *do* touch files, but only when you explicitly use them: the dependency panel runs `pnpm` and can rewrite `node_modules`, and "move session to workspace" rewrites that session's artifacts. See [Scope and permissions](#scope-and-permissions).

**Can I use it next to other DSH plugins?**
Yes. It coexists with the other plugins in your profile. Note that four interface issues reported from real use turned out to belong to the cost-meter and context-pilot plugins rather than this one — they are documented in [`docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md`](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md).

**Why are three assertions skipped?**
They validate the upstream monorepo's release contracts (`packages/`, `.github/workflows/`), which do not exist in this single-package fork. The files are kept with an explicit `SKIP` block instead of being deleted — see [Known limitations](#known-limitations).

**Is this an official plugin?**
No. It is a personal project with no endorsement from anyone (see the notice at the top).

Four layers, all runnable locally. `npm run gate` chains them and the `pre-push` hook runs it automatically; see the run snapshot in [`docs/BASELINE.md`](docs/BASELINE.md) for duration and test counts (minutes, not seconds, on a normal machine):

| Layer | Command | What it covers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Types | `npm run typecheck` | `tsc --noEmit` over `src` and `tests` |
| Unit / integration | `npm run test:unit` | 58 files (test count: see [`docs/BASELINE.md`](docs/BASELINE.md)) |
| Contract assertions | `node tests/run-assertions.mjs` | 66 scripts (pass/skip: see [`docs/BASELINE.md`](docs/BASELINE.md)) |
| Real-browser layout | `npm run test:layout` | 22 Chromium scripts measuring real geometry, interaction, contrast and overflow |

`npm run gate:host` is the heavy tier: it packs the plugin, installs it into an isolated `DSH_HOME`, starts a real `dsh web`, and runs three live-host scripts (about 1–2 minutes). Use it when you touch slots, injection, or the install flow.

The layout scripts need Playwright's Chromium once: `./node_modules/.bin/playwright install chromium`.
Recorded honestly in [`docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md`](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md) — the file is the source of truth, and everything below is expanded there:

- **Three assertions are skipped on purpose.** They validate the upstream monorepo's release contracts (`packages/`, `.github/workflows/`), which do not exist in this single-package fork. The files are kept with an explicit `SKIP` block rather than deleted, so "test missing" and "problem solved" stay distinguishable.
- **Compatibility boundary: built on 0.2.0-rc.2, run daily on 0.2.1-rc.2.** `engines.dsh` and the 11 peers all start at `>=0.2.0-rc.2`, because `devDependencies` are pinned there and this repo has never compiled against an earlier host. The upper bound stays `<0.3.0-0` on purpose: the author uses the plugin on 0.2.1-rc.2 every day, and narrowing it would lock real users out through the DSH version gate — but 0.2.1 has not entered the build or the gate. That difference is stated here rather than hidden inside a range that looks generous.
- **Four of the seven interface issues reported from real use are not this plugin's.** They were traced to the cost-meter and context-pilot plugins (duplicate cost display, cramped status bar) and to a host-built-in control; they are documented, not silently ignored.

This is a **beta** maintained by one person, so feedback is the main way it improves.

- **Something wrong or ugly?** Open an [issue](https://github.com/jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui/issues) — say what you expected, what happened instead, and attach a screenshot if it is visual. Screenshots of the sidebar and the composer are the most useful.
- **Idea or improvement?** Same place. Issues are fine for suggestions; there is no separate process.
- **Want to send a change?** See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) — `pnpm gate` must pass before a pull request is worth opening.
- **Before reporting**, please skim [`docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md`](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md): the known limitations are already written down there, including which issues are *not* this plugin's.

```bash
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build          # tsc --noEmit && tsdown  → lib/
pnpm gate           # typecheck + assertions + vitest + 22 browser scripts
pnpm gate:host      # isolated real-host compatibility tier

Every script is a plain `package.json` entry, so `npm run build` / `npm run gate` behave identically.
After changing `src`, rebuild before installing or committing. New features should reuse existing DSH slots and public services; do not depend on private host DOM or write conversation records.

readme.section: 每一个像素，都有出处。每一帧动效，都是刻意。
readme.text:
大多数皮肤是看着截图开始抄的。我们没有。

**dsh-zcode-ui** 是一个为期六周的设计继承工程的成果：没有任何东西——
一个圆角、一帧缓动——是靠猜的。我们用 Chrome DevTools Protocol 打开 ZCode 本体，
实时读取它的计算样式；解开它的启动页，逐字搬回关键帧；逐像素采样它的弹窗阴影。
然后，我们把这套语言在 DeepSeek Harness 里重建——14,480 行 TypeScript、85+ 模块、
一整个设计系统。

结果不是"模仿 ZCode"。是**在另一个应用里，原生地说 ZCode 的语言**。

而且它依然快：侧栏收起是一次 300ms 的滑动、**零长任务**；输入框在你的光标下
纹丝不动；启动的一瞬，你的应用图标在 macOS 毛玻璃上跃然而出、不到一秒就退场。

**实测，而非估算。守护，而非祈祷。**——这就是全部哲学，也是为什么这个皮肤
看起来不像换了个主题，而像 DeepSeek Harness 本该有的样子。

---

readme.section: 每一个像素，都有出处。每一帧动效，都是刻意。
readme.text:
> [!NOTE]
> **自 2.0.0 起为稳定版（当前 2.2.1）。** 皮肤里的每一个视觉值都能追溯到对 ZCode 的实机测量（CDP 计算样式或源码提取），由 66 个契约断言、57 个单元/集成测试文件与 22 个真机布局脚本守护——`npm run gate` 一条命令全跑，`pre-push` 钩子在任何东西进入 GitHub 之前执行同一道门禁。已知限制依旧如实列在 [`docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md`](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md) 里。
> **非常欢迎纠错和改进建议**——请直接开一个 [issue](https://github.com/jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui/issues)。最有用的反馈很简短：你期望看到什么、实际发生了什么，如果是视觉问题就附一张截图。

DSH ZCode UI 把 DSH Web 的界面重新绘制成 ZCode（智谱 Zai）的视觉语言：侧栏、工作区会话树、头部搜索、输入框全部采用 ZCode 的几何、配色与图标，明暗两套主题都是。

readme.section: 每一个像素，都有出处。每一帧动效，都是刻意。
readme.text:
**皮肤本身不改动别的东西。** 它绘制的一切仍然走 DSH 自己的 `SlotRegistry` 插槽与 `ctx` 公共服务，也从不写会话记录。

但有一点必须说清楚，因为上面这段话此前说宽了：本包是 [`dsh-codex-ui`](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui) 的 fork，**同时继承了上游的非视觉功能**——一个能运行 `pnpm`、可重写 `node_modules` 的依赖面板，工作区之间的会话移动，以及「在文件管理器中打开」。它们继承自上游（不是本仓库写的），也是「关于」页里暴露的那部分。**只用皮肤、不用这些功能完全可以**，但它们确实随本包一起发布。详见[能力范围与权限](#能力范围与权限)。

2.0.0 是六周设计继承工作的收官版本。每一个视觉决策——784px 正文列、32px 行高、两套弹窗语法、
动效令牌、启动画面——背后都是一条对 ZCode 本身的实测记录，而不是目测。完整台账在
[`docs/ZCODE-DESIGN.md`](docs/ZCODE-DESIGN.md)；被发现并关闭的缺口读起来就是 30+ 轮审计的
变更史（会话区排版、弹窗家族、轮次轨动效、启动画面、标题栏去重）——每一项都以
前后对照测量收口。

| 方面 | 皮肤做了什么 |
| --- | --- |
| **布局** | ZCode 侧栏几何——8px 圆角、32px 行高、`px-2 / py-3 / gap-1` 间距、150–200ms `ease-out` 动效、七档字号刻度 |
| **配色** | 完整的 Zai Light / Zai Dark 色板写入 DSH 的 `--dsw-*` 令牌层；标题栏、会话列表、按钮、菜单、输入壳等官方区域整体换色 |
| **图标** | 侧栏导航与行内操作使用 Lucide（与 ZCode 同一套图标库） |
| **主题** | 跟随宿主自身的明暗偏好（`body[data-ds-dark-theme]`）；亮色画布 `#f8f8f8`、暗色 `#161616` |
| **侧栏行为** | 项目与会话的置顶 / 分组 / 拖拽排序，未读与运行中指示；头部搜索覆盖会话、设置与快捷操作；重命名 / 归档 / 分叉 / 复制 / 删除；长会话轮次导航；空输入框按上/下键召回历史输入 |
| **会话工艺** | 784px 正文列、20px 轮组节奏、0.35px 字距、右对齐用户气泡可折叠、ZCode 级表格与引用块、围栏代码卡、禁止横向滚动 |
| **动效** | 按意图分档的动效令牌（进入 / 反馈 / 移动 / 按压），侧栏收起一次 300ms 滑动**零长任务**，入场动画共用一支——绝不同步失调 |
| **启动画面** | 电影感的启动层——你的应用图标在 macOS 毛玻璃上跃然而出，不到一秒退场，3 秒保险丝确保永远不会困住你 |
| **弹窗语法** | 一个家族作为唯一默认（独立设计评审 8/9 分）；重量级家族只留给阻断式确认——两族绝混用 |

本页顶部的两张是明暗两套的侧栏与工作区会话树。另外几处。

> 所有截图里的项目名、会话标题与余额数字都是**演示数据**——提交前会先做脱敏，
> 因此本仓库里不会出现任何真实工作区的内容。
>
> **截图已按 2.0.0 重拍**（2026-10-29），对真实宿主（`0.2.1-rc.2`）取景：收起态窄轨、
> 置顶标题栏（宿主重复按钮已隐藏）、平贴的输入卡与表格/引用样式，就是 2.0 的实际出厂观感。
> 只有演示数据——本仓库不包含任何真实工作区内容。

设置页 —— 选中态是中性灰，与侧栏一致（没有宿主默认的蓝色残留）：

收起态窄轨——纯图标 + 顶部展开钮，页脚图标钉在底部（深色）：

头部搜索，覆盖会话与设置：

折叠后的窄轨 —— 纯图标，悬停有提示：

- **ZCode 皮肤本体**——明暗两套各 178 个 `--dsw-*` 令牌，另加 23 个结构性令牌，合计 201 个唯一令牌名。`src/` 中出现的每一个被消费令牌都在映射表里，`token-coverage` 断言会在这一点不再成立时直接让构建失败。
- **主题单一真源**——只认宿主属性，不做 `prefers-color-scheme` 回退。旧做法在「宿主是亮色、系统是暗色」时会把侧栏与内容区撕成两半。
- **靠看真实界面发现的修复**，而不是靠读代码：会话悬停卡精简为只显示标题；发送键使用真正的主色（`--dcu-primary` 现在定义在 `:root`，输入区在 `.dcu-root` 之外才能解析到它）；全局面板打开时提供「返回会话」入口；删掉侧栏自绘的分隔线；标题跑马灯不再裁掉两端；底栏分组分隔；空状态卡收矮。
- **一套真能跑起来的验证栈**——见[验证](#验证)。上游那批真浏览器布局脚本此前在本机**从未真正执行过**（缺 Chromium 二进制），这也正是 5 条过期断言长期没被发现的原因。

一个皮肤本不该需要一段权限说明。这个需要，因为它是 fork，继承的不只是视觉。说清楚比「被默认信任」便宜。

| 能力 | 从哪里触发 | 会碰什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 给界面换色 | 安装即生效 | DSH 的 `--dsw-*` 令牌层与本插件自己的样式表。不碰数据。 |
| 侧栏 / 会话树 / 搜索 | 安装即生效 | 走官方插槽渲染。读取会话与工作区列表；从不写会话记录。 |
| 依赖面板 | 「关于」页，点击触发 | 在当前工作区运行 `pnpm`，可重写 `node_modules` 与 `pnpm-workspace.yaml`。 |
| 移动会话到工作区 | 会话右键菜单 | 重写该会话的工件文件。 |
| 在文件管理器中打开 | 路径菜单 | 打开系统文件管理器。只读。 |
| 五个 REST 端点 | 仅本插件自己的界面 | 承载上面四项功能；按会话鉴权。 |
下表后四行**全部继承自 [`dsh-codex-ui`](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui)**，并且在 DSH 内的「关于」页也一并暴露。只要皮肤的话，这些功能你不点就不会运行。

- 一个可用的 **DeepSeek Harness Web**，且 `dsh` 在 `PATH` 上。下文示例使用 `web` profile，请替换成你自己的 profile 名。
- **主机兼容性。** peer 依赖声明的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` 范围为 `>=0.1.6-alpha.2 <0.3.0-0`，开发期固定为 `0.2.0-rc.2`。重型档 `pnpm gate:host` 会把插件打包、装进隔离的 `DSH_HOME`，并用本机真实的 `dsh` 二进制跑一遍安装链路（可用 `DCU_DSH_BIN` 覆盖）。
- 从源码构建需要 **Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`**。
- ⚠️ macOS 上构建或测试时，**不要**把 DSH 自带的 Node 24 放在 `PATH` 最前面：它加载不了 `rolldown` 的原生绑定（`code signature ... different Team IDs`），`vitest` / `tsdown` 会直接失败。换成任意 22.22.x 即可。

本包**未发布到 npm 仓库**，直接从 GitHub 安装即可——`dsh plugin` 会把参数原样转发给 `pnpm`，
而 pnpm 原生支持 `github:<owner>/<repo>` 这种写法：

```text
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui
```

`lib/` 已随仓库提交，且本包没有 `prepare` 脚本，所以安装过程不会触发任何编译。

把下面这段发给任何能执行终端命令的智能体：

```text
请把 DSH 插件 dsh-zcode-ui 装进我本地的 web profile，执行：
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui
然后运行 dsh --profile web --dump-config，确认配置里出现 zcode-ui，并告诉我怎么重载 DSH、怎么开始使用这套皮肤。
```

```powershell
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
$OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui
dsh --profile web --dump-config

重启 DSH Web 并硬刷新浏览器（一般是 `Ctrl+Shift+R`）。看到新侧栏就说明皮肤生效了。停用或卸载插件即可恢复官方界面。

readme.section: 从本地克隆安装（用于未发布的改动）
readme.text:
```powershell
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
$OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
git clone https://github.com/jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui.git
Set-Location .\dsh-zcode-ui

`lib/` 已随仓库提交，克隆下来不构建也能用——但改过 `src/` 后必须重新构建。**装依赖必须用 `pnpm`**：`pnpm-workspace.yaml` 用 `packageExtensions` 为 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 补了 19 个未申报依赖，而 `npm` 不读这套机制，`npm install` 之后 `tsdown` 会因为解析不到这些包而失败。只有在依赖已用 pnpm 装好的前提下，「用 `npm run <script>` 执行脚本」才是等价的。

重载 DSH Web 后，左侧导航就由本插件渲染。

| 想做什么 | 怎么做 |
| --- | --- |
| 开新会话 | **新建任务**，或用工作区上的 **+** / **新建会话** |
| 找东西 | 在头部搜索框输入，从会话、设置页、快捷操作里挑 |
| 收起侧栏 | 头部面板按钮；收起后的窄条上仍留有展开控件 |
| 从全局面板返回 | 面板打开时，面板入口正下方会出现**返回会话** |
| 置顶项目 | 把它拖进**置顶**区，或用项目菜单里的**置顶项目** |
| 管理会话 | 打开会话菜单：重命名、置顶、标记未读、归档、分叉、复制、删除 |
| 复用历史输入 | 空输入框按上/下键，召回本工作区提交过的内容 |
| 在轮次间跳转 | 用当前会话左侧的轮次标记 |

**装完了，界面没变化？**
先确认你装的 profile 就是正在运行 DSH Web 的那个，然后重启 DSH Web 并硬刷新浏览器（`Ctrl+Shift+R`）。`dsh --profile web --dump-config` 的输出里应该能看到 `zcode-ui`。如果该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里还留着 `ui-sidebar` 或 `ui-settings-general` 的 `disabled: true`，把那几行删掉再重载。

**会不会动我的会话、工作区或文件？**
皮肤本身不会。它只通过 DSH 的 `--dsw-*` 令牌层给界面换色，并通过官方插槽与公共服务渲染侧栏。它从不写会话记录；把项目从侧栏移除也不会删除任何文件夹。

有两项**继承来的**功能确实会碰文件，但只在你主动使用时：依赖面板会运行 `pnpm` 并可重写 `node_modules`，「移动会话到工作区」会重写该会话的工件文件。详见[能力范围与权限](#能力范围与权限)。

**能和别的 DSH 插件一起用吗？**
可以，与 profile 里的其他插件共存。需要说明的是：实机反馈的 4 个界面问题实际属于计费插件与 context-pilot，不归本插件——详见 [`docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md`](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md)。

**为什么有 3 个断言是跳过的？**
它们校验的是上游 monorepo 的发布契约（`packages/`、`.github/workflows/`），而本仓库是单包 fork，被测对象不存在。文件被保留并加显式 `SKIP` 块，而不是删除——见[已知限制](#已知限制)。

**这是官方插件吗？**
不是。这是个人项目，没有得到任何方面的背书（见文首声明）。

四层，都能在本地跑。`npm run gate` 把它们串成一条，`pre-push` 钩子会自动执行；耗时与用例数见 [`docs/BASELINE.md`](docs/BASELINE.md) 的实跑快照（本机正常负载下是分钟级，别按"几十秒"安排）：

| 层级 | 命令 | 覆盖范围 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 类型 | `npm run typecheck` | `tsc --noEmit`，覆盖 `src` 与 `tests` |
| 单元 / 集成 | `npm run test:unit` | 58 个文件（用例数见 [`docs/BASELINE.md`](docs/BASELINE.md)） |
| 契约断言 | `node tests/run-assertions.mjs` | 66 个脚本（通过 / 跳过见 [`docs/BASELINE.md`](docs/BASELINE.md)） |
| 真机布局 | `npm run test:layout` | 22 个 Chromium 脚本，量真实几何、交互、对比度与溢出 |

`npm run gate:host` 是重型档：把插件打包、装进一个隔离的 `DSH_HOME`、起真实的 `dsh web`，再跑三个活宿主脚本（约 1–2 分钟）。改动插槽、注入或安装流程时用它。

布局脚本需要一次性安装 Playwright 自带的 Chromium：`./node_modules/.bin/playwright install chromium`。
都在 [`docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md`](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md) 里如实记录——那份文件是唯一真源，以下每一条在其中都有完整展开：

- **有 3 个断言是有意跳过的。** 它们校验的是上游 monorepo 的发布契约（`packages/`、`.github/workflows/`），而本仓库是单包 fork，被测对象根本不存在。文件被保留并加显式 `SKIP` 块，而不是删除——删除会让「测试不见了」和「问题解决了」难以区分。
- **兼容性边界：构建在 0.2.0-rc.2，日常运行在 0.2.1-rc.2。** `engines.dsh` 与 11 个 peer 的下界都是 `>=0.2.0-rc.2`（因为 `devDependencies` 钉在那里，本仓从未在更早的宿主上编译过）。上界保持 `<0.3.0-0` 是有意的：作者本人每天在 0.2.1-rc.2 上用它，收窄会把你挡在版本门禁外；但 0.2.1 确实没有进入构建与门禁——这个差别写在这里，而不是藏在一个看起来很宽的范围里。
- **实机反馈的 7 个界面问题里，有 4 个不归本插件。** 它们被查到属于计费插件与 context-pilot（费用重复显示、状态栏拥挤），以及宿主内置控件；已记录在案，没有静默忽略。
- **上游两个 issue（[#40](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui/issues/40)、[#41](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui/issues/41)）经探测未复现**（macOS、四种窗口尺寸）。两句都已不再是「未结」：上游于 2026-10-13 以 `state_reason=completed` 关闭（2026-10-18 复核）。非 macOS 平台、真实系统缩放、全屏/分屏仍未验证。
- **CI 配置已就绪，但还差一次手动启用。** [`docs/ci/workflow-ci.yml`](docs/ci/workflow-ci.yml) 就是那条 workflow：push 与 PR 上执行 `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 加 `node scripts/gate.mjs`，与 `pre-push` 钩子是同一份，所以「本地绿 == CI 绿」由同一个命令保证。它没能直接落在 `.github/workflows/`：用于推送的凭据只有 `repo` scope，GitHub 拒绝创建 workflow 文件（`refusing to allow an OAuth App to create or update workflow ... without workflow scope`）。把它复制到 `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 并 push，或换一个带 `workflow` scope 的 token，即可启用。**

没有这些项目，就没有这个插件：

| 项目 | 在这里的角色 |
| --- | --- |
| [MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui)（Apache-2.0） | fork 的父项目——侧栏、工作区会话树、搜索、轮次导航、设置骨架、测试工具链与数据层思路都来自它。本 fork 基于它的 `1.1.34`，再加上 ZCode 皮肤与上述修复。 |
| [zai-org/ZCode](https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode)（Apache-2.0） | 设计来源——色板、几何、图标选型与动效值均取自它（已与 v3.15.1 逐项核对）。 |
| [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) | 本插件所挂载的宿主程序。 |
| [Lucide](https://lucide.dev/) | 侧栏使用的图标库。 |

仓库内值得一读的存档：

- [`docs/ZCODE-DESIGN.md`](docs/ZCODE-DESIGN.md) —— 从 ZCode 提取的完整设计规范。
- [`docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md`](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md) —— 已知问题、跳过的断言、环境遗留、发布前检查清单。
- [`docs/UPSTREAM-CHANGELOG.md`](docs/UPSTREAM-CHANGELOG.md) —— fork 点之前的上游更新日志。
- [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) —— 怎么构建、怎么验证、怎么提交。

这是一个**测试版**，且由一个人维护，所以反馈是它变好的主要途径。

- **哪里不对、哪里难看？** 开一个 [issue](https://github.com/jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui/issues)：说明你期望什么、实际发生了什么，视觉问题请附截图——侧栏与输入框的截图最有用。
- **有想法或改进建议？** 同样开 issue 就行，没有别的流程。
- **想直接提交改动？** 见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)——提交前 `pnpm gate` 必须全绿。
- **报之前先扫一眼** [`docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md`](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md)：已知限制都写在里面了，包括哪些问题**不归本插件**。

```bash
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build          # tsc --noEmit && tsdown  → lib/
pnpm gate           # 类型 + 断言 + vitest + 22 个浏览器脚本
pnpm gate:host      # 隔离真实宿主的兼容性重型档

所有脚本都是 `package.json` 里的普通条目，用 `npm run build` / `npm run gate` 效果完全一致。

改完 `src` 要先构建再安装或提交。新功能应复用 DSH 既有插槽与公共服务，不要依赖宿主私有 DOM，也不要写会话记录。
